name: Orbit Guard 2
about: Orbit Guard 2 (2025-038, INFORB), launched 2025 Feb 27. Its phases from GCAT: Luna, Earth. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
